Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: American Military Surplus Co. specializes in the retail of legally sourced military surplus items, including authentic military clothing, camping gear, and outdoor supplies. Our operations also include the refurbishment of select surplus goods, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations such as ITAR and EAR. We maintain a secure facility equipped with an active video surveillance system and employee training programs to mitigate theft and liability risks. Our inventory is appraised annually to reflect current market values, supporting accurate insurance coverage and management practices. We pride ourselves on conducting transparent transactions and providing exceptional customer service both in-store and through our compliant online platform.
